title: User Need and AI Contribution
outcome: By the end, I can explain user need and ai contribution using a traced example and a stated limitation.
scenario: Define a useful reading helper before choosing its AI features.
given: A pupil needs the meaning of unfamiliar words in an approved glossary. G3 defines habitat as the place an organism lives; no other sources are allowed.
All inputs and outcomes in this worked example are invented classroom data; no real model run is claimed.

steps.label: Name the need
steps.detail: The pupil wants a glossary meaning, not a made-up example presented as a fact.

steps.label: Choose contribution
steps.detail: The assistant locates the glossary entry and restates it in clear language with G3.

steps.label: Bound the service
steps.detail: An absent word produces “not in this glossary”; a direct glossary search is the baseline.

explanation: Read the picture in order. An absent word produces “not in this glossary”; a direct glossary search is the baseline. The arrows show which recorded input or intermediate result each decision uses. Explain the deciding step aloud before checking the changed case; pointing to the final answer alone does not show how it follows.

counterfactual.change: The pupil asks for photosynthesis, which G3 does not contain.
counterfactual.prediction: The assistant reports that the definition is unavailable in its approved glossary.
counterfactual.reason: A helpful interface cannot expand its authorised evidence by guessing.

student_task: What non-AI baseline would reveal whether this helper adds value? Point to the relevant step in the picture, then write the changed result and the rule or evidence that supports it.
teacher_answer: Ask the same pupils to use direct glossary search on the same word tasks; compare supported answers and effort without inventing results. Changed-case check: The assistant reports that the definition is unavailable in its approved glossary. A helpful interface cannot expand its authorised evidence by guessing.
project_evidence: For your Verified Study Buddy, save the input, procedure, observed result and limitation of this check. Label this worked example as practice; use a different, previously unreviewed case when checking independent understanding.
limits: A requirements plan identifies intended value; it does not demonstrate actual pupil benefit.
review_note: Reviewed User Need and AI Contribution against the assigned lesson pack and its reserved independent case. Added a different explicit worked scenario, an auditable trace and a changed-input check; preserved the original curriculum and assessment boundary.
